question: Why does this view accommodate all doctrines?
premises: in this view all doctrines have a fitting standing
in the all-enduring view nothing is faulted
inference: The verse claims the accepted view can include all doctrines without fault.
uncertainties: whether sarvaṃsahe modifies pakṣe or sthiti
plain_english: In this view, even all doctrines have a fitting standing; in the all-enduring view, nothing is indeed faulted.
